bullets.text: AI-Powered App Development - Microsoft showcased building a cloud-native app in under 30 minutes using **VS Code**, **GitHub Copilot**, and the **Microsoft Agent Framework**.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New build introduces **Ask Copilot** in the taskbar for enhanced user interaction and productivity.
Shared Audio Feature - Windows 11 now supports sharing audio between two Bluetooth devices, enhancing user experience.
Enhanced Edge Security - **Scareware blocker** is now enabled by default, providing proactive protection against scams.
Mixed Reality Productivity - **Windows 11** and **Meta Quest** integration now generally available, enhancing immersive work environments.
AI Evaluation Tools - New libraries for .NET developers help ensure AI applications produce reliable and safe outputs.
Next Steps with OpenAI - Microsoft strengthens its partnership with **OpenAI**, focusing on responsible AI advancement.
